news.window.note: Only articles from the last 2 days belong in a news sitemap.

news.max_urls.note: At most 1,000 articles per news sitemap.

title.has_publication_name.note: Titles go in without the publication name.

title.has_author.note: Titles go in without the author. Checked against the author name WordPress holds for the article.

title.has_date.note: Titles go in without the date. News Distribution looks for a written date such as 21/10/2026 or 2026-10-21, so it can miss a date written in words.

entry.required_tags.note: Publication name, language, publication date and title on every entry. Listed on the design board; the verify log confirms only the window, the 1,000 limit and the title rules.

publication_name.missing.note: The name must match the one Google News shows on your articles. News Distribution cannot read news.google.com to compare.

publication_name.long.note: A limit of 80 characters set by News Distribution. Google does not state one.

url.missing.note: Every entry needs the article address.

language.file.note: One sitemap file per language. Google does not publish which languages Google News accepts, so News Distribution cannot say whether a language is included.
